MACD 히스토그램은 -0.3035에서 -0.6326으로 악화되며 약세 수렴 지속. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.85로 위축된 움직임. 20일 저가 대비 5일 저가 상승(Higher Low) 패턴 미확인. 현재가 $60.55는 SMA20 $65.23 하회, SMA200 $64.81 하회하며 중장기 이평선 하방 압력. 주봉 RSI 42.1, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -1.6347로 약세 추세 지속. ADX 26.9로 뚜렷한 추세는 있으나 -DI(37.9)가 +DI(14.2)보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 우세. 변동성 ATR $2.56 (4.22%) 고려 시, 현재가 대비 1.3배 손절(ATR 1.3배 = $3.33) 적용 시 손절가 $57.22, 2.6배 목표(ATR 2.6배 = $6.66) 적용 시 목표가 $67.21. 손익비 1.99로 양호하나, 약세 추세 및 지표 악화 지속으로 매수 진입은 부적절. 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 2 trading sessions. RSI edged up slightly from 38.5 to 39.1 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram worsened from -0.3035 to -0.6326, continuing the bearish convergence. Volume ratio at 0.85 relative to the 5-day average indicates subdued activity. Higher Low pattern (5-day low above 20-day low) remains unconfirmed. Current price $60.55 is below SMA20 $65.23 and SMA200 $64.81, indicating downward pressure from medium to long-term moving averages. Weekly RSI is 42.1 and weekly MACD histogram is -1.6347, suggesting a continued downtrend. ADX at 26.9 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (37.9) is above +DI (14.2), favoring downward pressure. Considering volatility (ATR $2.56 or 4.22%), a 1.3x ATR stop loss ($3.33) would be $57.22, and a 2.6x ATR target ($6.66) would be $67.21, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1.99. However, due to the persistent downtrend and deteriorating indicators, initiating a buy position is not advisable. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
